claim: You deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises as a virtual machine on VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, Linux KVM or Nutanix AHV, or as a hardware appliance that you order from a reseller; you can also deploy the Storage Gateway VM in VMware Cloud on AWS or as an AMI in Amazon EC2.

values.display: VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM), or Nutanix AHV
as an AMI in Amazon EC2

qualifiers.scope: Amazon S3 File Gateway (AWS Storage Gateway)

evidence.quote: You deploy the gateway into your on-premises environment as a virtual machine (VM) running on VMware ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, Linux Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM), or Nutanix AHV, or as a hardware appliance that you order from your preferred reseller. You can also deploy the Storage Gateway VM in VMware Cloud on AWS, or as an AMI in Amazon EC2.

note: adjudicate-25: repaired from the FAQ quote, which spells the hypervisor 'Nutanix AVM'; the user guides, the 2025-12-22 What's New post and the Requirements pages name it Nutanix AHV. Scope narrowed to S3 File Gateway because the new quote is from its user guide (the Tape and Volume Gateway guides list the same hypervisors). Writers: the Storage Gateway Hardware Appliance is no longer offered to new customers; see storage-gateway-hardware-appliance-end-of-availability before teaching the hardware appliance as a current option.
